description: This file defines the Vacancy entity class within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin, including its properties, ORM mappings, and accessor methods.

classes.name: Vacancy
classes.description: Entity class representing a job vacancy, including details such as job title, hiring manager, description, status, and timestamps.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the vacancy.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the vacancy.

methods.name: getJobTitle
methods.description: Retrieves the associated JobTitle entity.

methods.name: setJobTitle
methods.description: Assigns a JobTitle entity to this vacancy.

methods.name: getHiringManager
methods.description: Retrieves the hiring manager Employee entity, if any.

methods.name: setHiringManager
methods.description: Assigns an Employee entity as the hiring manager.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Gets the name of the vacancy.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the vacancy.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of the vacancy.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description for the vacancy.

methods.name: getNumOfPositions
methods.description: Returns the number of positions available for this vacancy.

methods.name: setNumOfPositions
methods.description: Sets the number of positions.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Checks if the vacancy is active.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the vacancy's active/inactive status.

methods.name: isPublished
methods.description: Indicates whether the vacancy is published in the feed.

methods.name: setIsPublished
methods.description: Sets the publication status of the vacancy.

methods.name: getDefinedTime
methods.description: Retrieves the datetime when the vacancy was defined.

methods.name: setDefinedTime
methods.description: Sets the time when the vacancy was defined.

methods.name: getUpdatedTime
methods.description: Retrieves the last update time of the vacancy.

methods.name: setUpdatedTime
methods.description: Sets the last update time of the vacancy.
